mcat_description.short: Security Cabins are compact prefabricated structures designed to shelter security guards at entry and exit points of residential, commercial, and industrial premises, sold as ready-made or custom-built units in steel, PUF-panel, FRP, or PVC construction.
mcat_description.long: Security Cabins are factory-manufactured portable guard posts built on a mild steel or galvanised steel frame with insulated wall panels (PUF, EPS, FRP, or PVC) and a weatherproof roof, designed for rapid on-site deployment without deep foundations. They are available in standard footprints (4×4 ft to 8×8 ft and beyond) and can be customised for dimensions, door/window placement, interior electrical fittings, and finish colour. The structures are used across gated residential communities, industrial gates, construction sites, corporate campuses, toll plazas, and government installations as a functional workspace for on-duty security personnel. Sellers supply them per piece for standard sizes or quote per sq ft for larger custom configurations, with pan-India delivery and optional installation and AMC support.

market_context: Security Cabins in India are a well-established segment within the broader prefabricated structures market, manufactured and sold by hundreds of SME fabricators and organised prefab companies pan-India, with manufacturing hubs in Delhi-NCR, Thane/Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Ahmedabad, and Hyderabad. The dominant commercial form is a compact steel-framed cabin with PUF or EPS insulated sandwich panels, available in standard footprints of 4×4 ft, 4×6 ft, 6×6 ft, 6×8 ft, and 8×8 ft, with custom sizes available. Material variants include MS sheet, PUF panel, FRP, PVC, GI sheet, and rockwool-insulated panels — buyers select based on durability, insulation need, and budget. Key buyer vocabulary includes 'guard cabin', 'watchman cabin', 'guard room', 'security booth', and 'police booth'; the last two are used for government/municipal deployments but represent the same product family. Organised manufacturers such as EPACK Prefab hold ISO 9001:2015 certification and offer pan-India supply with AMC; the unorganised segment (local fabricators) is large and competes on price. Structures are quoted per piece for standard sizes and per sq ft for custom builds; typical lifespan is approximately 20 years. No specific BIS/IS standard governs security cabins as a product category — quality is governed by the material standards of constituent components (steel grade, panel density, PPGI sheet thickness).
